title: Kirk's Ridges
blurb: Kirk's Ridges offers beekeeping gear, hives, and accessories, plus wine kits, fermentation equipment, and bottling supplies. They provide hands-on classes on beekeeping and winemaking, tastings, and community gatherings. The business caters to hobbyists passionate about nature and homemade delights.
